bio: In the heart of a farm in the Lanaudière region, this country restaurant delivers a full farm-to-plate experience. In a timber-built barn overlooking the countryside, Loïc Leperlier cooks instinctively with local produce: vegetables, herbs, free-range birds and house-made maple syrup. Made to order, the dishes on the single set menu faithfully follow the harvests and are dotted with nods to the chef's Réunion Island roots. Jessica Grégoire extends a warm welcome, adding a personal touch to the service.
